tools.name: delete_user_account
tools.description: Permanently deletes a user account along with the user's sessions and profile rows from the database. Returns how many rows were removed.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the account to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "accounts.db"


@dataclass
class DeleteResult:
    user_id: int
    deleted: bool
    sessions_removed: int
    profiles_removed: int
    message: str


@function_tool
def delete_user_account(user_id: int) -> DeleteResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
        if cur.fetchone() is None:
            return DeleteResult(user_id, False, 0, 0, "user not found")

        cur.execute("DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        sessions = cur.rowcount
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM profiles WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
        profiles = cur.rowcount
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
        removed = cur.rowcount > 0
        conn.commit()
        return DeleteResult(
            user_id,
            removed,
            sessions,
            profiles,
            "account deleted" if removed else "nothing deleted",
        )
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        return DeleteResult(user_id, False, 0, 0, f"database error: {exc}")
    finally:
        conn.close()
